sections[2].blocks[1].html:
Want to start your store today or migrate from another platform?
Leave us your details and we will contact you for a free consultation with a Shopify expert.
sections[3].blocks[1].q: How quickly can you build a Shopify store?
sections[3].blocks[1].a: In record time. We can have your store fully working in under a week, depending on the number of products and customizations. Ideal if you need to launch fast or migrate from another platform.
sections[3].blocks[2].q: How much does a Shopify store built by Agencia IDP cost?
sections[3].blocks[2].a: The price depends on the level of customization, number of products and extra features (such as integrations or premium design). Contact us for a no-obligation custom quote.
sections[3].blocks[3].q: Do you upload the products and set everything up?
sections[3].blocks[3].a: Yes, we offer an all-inclusive service: we upload your products and set up payment gateways, shipping methods, domain, SSL certificates and more. We also show you how to manage your store.
sections[3].blocks[4].q: Can I sell in Colombia and abroad with Shopify?
sections[3].blocks[4].a: Absolutely. Shopify lets you sell locally and internationally. We set up your store to accept payments in different currencies, adjust shipping costs and sell in multiple countries.
sections[3].blocks[5].q: What if I already have a store and want to migrate to Shopify?
sections[3].blocks[5].a: We handle the full migration of your e-commerce from platforms like WooCommerce, Wix, PrestaShop or TiendaNube, keeping your inventory, customers and order history whenever possible.
sections[3].blocks[6].q: Will the store work on mobile?
sections[3].blocks[6].a: Yes. All our designs are 100% responsive and adapt to phones, tablets and any device. A good mobile experience is key to your sales.
